summary: Declare metric thresholds in KDL; the daemon evaluates conditions in the background and notifies owners once on breach and recovery.

replay.detail: No claim replay is required. The background evaluator builds local condition heads and a retry queue from condition.state claims in bounded pages.

schema.detail: Adds the condition subject, root declaration and system-only durable condition.state claim. Registry digest expands. Storage version stays 18; three local condition cache/counter/notification tables and a desired-condition index are created on store open.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule changes; condition.state has no trimming rule and remains durable. Public claim writes cannot publish condition.state.

compatibility.detail: Additive /v1/conditions read and st conditions ls/show commands. Older daemons cannot parse condition declarations or interpret condition.state claims. Upgrade every member before publishing conditions, daemon before CLI.

downtime.detail: Ordinary daemon restart; existing breaches resume silently and pending holds start again. Kernel probes and evaluation run only on the background task every 30 seconds.

manual.detail: Operations must deploy all fleet daemons before publishing the first conditions. Keep existing watches until real-host breach/recovery verification and operations approval.

recovery.detail: Roll forward after conditions have been published; an older daemon cannot evaluate the new declarations. Notification retries use durable recorded transition details and deterministic message identities.
